origin.description: Draw a Braille sparkline, two values per character.
origin.details: An odd length is padded with a missing value. UTF-8 output maps each pair through findInterval and the Braille bit order. Otherwise each pair is averaged and drawn with the four ASCII bars.

translation.description: Draw a Braille sparkline, two values per character.
translation.details: An odd length is padded with a missing value. UTF-8 output maps each pair through findInterval and the Braille bit order. Otherwise each pair is averaged and drawn with the four ASCII bars.
translation.example:
from cli import options, spark_line
options(**{"cli.unicode": True})
print(spark_line([i / 9 for i in range(10)]))
